    function renderManagement() {
      const data = state.management;
      if (!data) return;

      $('create-team-form').hidden = !data.permissions?.canCreateTeam;

      $('manage-teams').innerHTML = (data.teams || []).map(team => {
        const president = (data.members || []).find(member =>
          member.team?.teamId === team.id
          && member.team?.role === 'president'
          && member.team?.status === 'active'
        );

        const canRename = Boolean(
          data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin
          || data.permissions?.myPresidentTeamId === team.id
        );

        const canDelete = data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin === true;
        const canManageOverview = Boolean(
          data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin
          || data.permissions?.canAssignPresident
        );

        return `
          <div class="compact-row manage-team-row">
            <div class="manage-team-identity">
              <strong>${esc(team.name)}</strong>
              <small>${president ? `Presidente: ${esc(president.username)}` : 'Presidente non assegnato'}</small>
              ${team.auction_alias ? `<small class="manage-team-alias-readout">Alias asta: <b>${esc(team.auction_alias)}</b></small>` : ''}
            </div>

            <div class="manage-team-actions">
              ${canManageOverview ? `
                <button
                  class="secondary team-icon-btn manage-team-overview"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Gestisci alias e Presidente"
                  aria-label="Gestisci alias e Presidente di ${esc(team.name)}"
                >⚙</button>
              ` : ''}

              ${canRename ? `
                <button
                  class="secondary team-icon-btn rename-team"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  data-name="${esc(team.name)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Rinomina squadra"
                  aria-label="Rinomina ${esc(team.name)}"
                >✎</button>
              ` : ''}

              ${canDelete ? `
                <button
                  class="danger team-icon-btn delete-team"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  data-name="${esc(team.name)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Elimina squadra"
                  aria-label="Elimina ${esc(team.name)}"
                >×</button>
              ` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('') || '<div class="small soft">Nessuna squadra.</div>';

      $('manage-teams').querySelectorAll('.manage-team-overview').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => openManageTeamModal(button.dataset.team));
      });

      $('manage-teams').querySelectorAll('.rename-team').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const currentName = button.dataset.name || '';
          const raw = await appPrompt('Nuovo nome squadra', currentName);
          if (raw === null) return;
          const teamName = raw.trim().toLocaleUpperCase('it-IT');
          if (teamName.length < 2 || teamName.length > 60) {
            return msg('Il nome della squadra deve avere tra 2 e 60 caratteri.', 'error');
          }
          if (teamName === currentName) return;

          try {
            await api(ENDPOINTS.league, {
              action: 'renameTeam',
              teamId: button.dataset.team,
              teamName
            });
            msg('Squadra rinominata.', 'success');
            await Promise.all([loadManagement(), loadDashboard()]);
          } catch (error) {
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          }
        });
      });

      $('manage-teams').querySelectorAll('.delete-team').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const teamName = button.dataset.name || 'questa squadra';
          if (!await appConfirm(`Eliminare ${teamName}? La squadra verrà rimossa dalle squadre attive, mantenendo lo storico già registrato.`)) {
            return;
          }
          try {
            await api(ENDPOINTS.league, {
              action: 'deleteTeam',
              teamId: button.dataset.team
            });
            msg('Squadra eliminata.', 'success');
            await Promise.all([loadManagement(), loadDashboard()]);
          } catch (error) {
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          }
        });
      });

      $('manage-members').innerHTML = (data.members || []).map(member => {
        const roles = new Set(member.leagueRoles || []);
        return `
          <div class="compact-row">
            <div>
              <strong>${esc(member.username)}</strong>
              <small>${member.team ? `${esc(roleLabel(member.team.role))} · ${esc(member.team.teamName)} · ${esc(member.team.status)}` : 'Nessuna squadra'}</small>
            </div>
            ${data.permissions?.canManageRoles ? `
              <div class="row member-role-controls" data-user="${esc(member.userId)}">
                ${['league_admin','auctioneer','presenter'].map(role => `
                  <label class="check-line"><input type="checkbox" data-role="${role}" ${roles.has(role) ? 'checked' : ''}>${esc(roleLabel(role))}</label>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
            ` : `<div class="row">${[...roles].map(role => `<span class="badge">${esc(roleLabel(role))}</span>`).join('')}</div>`}
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('') || '<div class="small soft">Nessun membro.</div>';

      $('manage-members').querySelectorAll('.member-role-controls input').forEach(input => {
        input.addEventListener('change', async () => {
          const parent = input.closest('.member-role-controls');
          try {
            await api(ENDPOINTS.league, {
              action: 'setMemberRole',
              targetUserId: parent.dataset.user,
              role: input.dataset.role,
              enabled: input.checked
            });
            msg('Ruolo aggiornato.', 'success');
            await loadManagement();
          } catch (error) {
            input.checked = !input.checked;
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          }
        });
      });

      $('vice-requests-panel').hidden = !(data.permissions?.canApproveVice && (data.viceRequests || []).length);
      $('vice-requests').innerHTML = (data.viceRequests || []).map(item => `
        <div class="compact-row">
          <div><strong>${esc(item.username)}</strong><small>${item.leagueApproved ? 'Admin approvato' : 'Attesa Admin'} · ${item.presidentApproved ? 'Presidente approvato' : 'Attesa Presidente'}</small></div>
          <div class="row"><button class="approve-vice good" data-user="${esc(item.userId)}">Approva</button><button class="reject-vice danger" data-user="${esc(item.userId)}">Rifiuta</button></div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      $('vice-requests').querySelectorAll('.approve-vice').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => viceAction('approveVice', button.dataset.user)));
      $('vice-requests').querySelectorAll('.reject-vice').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => viceAction('rejectVice', button.dataset.user)));
    }

    $('create-team-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const teamName = $('manage-new-team').value.trim().toLocaleUpperCase('it-IT');
      if (teamName.length < 2) return msg('Nome squadra non valido.', 'error');
      try {
        await api(ENDPOINTS.league, { action: 'createTeam', teamName });
        $('manage-new-team').value = '';
        msg('Squadra creata.', 'success');
        await loadManagement();
      } catch (error) { msg(error.message, 'error'); }
    });

    async function viceAction(action, targetUserId) {
      try {
        await api(ENDPOINTS.league, { action, targetUserId });
        msg(action === 'approveVice' ? 'Vice approvato.' : 'Richiesta Vice rifiutata.', 'success');
        await loadManagement();
      } catch (error) { msg(error.message, 'error'); }
    }

    /* =====================================================
       SETUP
       ===================================================== */

    async function loadSetup() {
      let settings = null;

      /* Fonte primaria: league_settings via league-api. */
      const direct = await api(
        ENDPOINTS.league,
        { action: 'getSetup' },
        { quiet: true }
      );

      if (direct?.ok && direct.settings) {
        settings = direct.settings;
      }

      /*
       * Fallback: auction-api legge la stessa league_settings
       * per costruire la lobby. Utile se il browser sta ancora
       * parlando con una vecchia revisione di league-api.
       */
      if (!settings) {
        const lobby = await api(
          ENDPOINTS.auction,
          { action: 'getLobby' },
          { quiet: true }
        );

        if (lobby?.ok && lobby.settings) {
          settings = lobby.settings;
        }
      }

      if (!settings) {
        throw new Error('Impossibile leggere il Setup salvato nel database.');
      }

      state.setup = settings;
      populateSetup(settings);
    }

    function parseRosterConfig(value) {
      if (!value) return {};
      if (typeof value === 'object') return value;

      try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
      } catch {
        return {};
      }
    }

    async function membershipAction(action, targetUserId) {
      try {
        await api(ENDPOINTS.league, { action, targetUserId });
        msg(action === 'approveMember' ? 'Richiesta approvata.' : 'Richiesta rifiutata.', 'success');
        await Promise.all([loadDashboard(), state.view === 'manage' ? loadManagement() : Promise.resolve()]);
      } catch (error) {
        msg(error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

       GESTIONE MEMBRI / SQUADRE

    async function loadManagement() {
      const data = await api(ENDPOINTS.league, { action: 'getManagementData' });
      if (!data) return;
      state.management = data;
      renderManagement();
    }

    function closeManageTeamModal() {
      const dialog = $('manage-team-modal');
      if (dialog?.open) {
        dialog.close();
      }
    }

    function openManageTeamModal(teamId) {
      const data = state.management;
      const dialog = $('manage-team-modal');
      const content = $('manage-team-modal-content');
      if (!data || !dialog || !content) return;

      const team = (data.teams || []).find(item => item.id === teamId);
      if (!team) return;

      const president = (data.members || []).find(member =>
        member.team?.teamId === team.id
        && member.team?.role === 'president'
        && member.team?.status === 'active'
      );

      const candidates = (data.members || []).filter(member =>
        member.canBePresident !== false
        && !member.team
      );

      const canAlias = data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin === true;
      const canManagePresident = data.permissions?.canAssignPresident === true;

      content.innerHTML = `
        <div class="manage-team-modal-card">
          <div class="manage-team-modal-head">
            <div>
              <small>MODIFICA SQUADRA</small>
              <h3>${esc(team.name)}</h3>
            </div>
            <button id="manage-team-modal-close" class="secondary manage-modal-close" type="button" aria-label="Chiudi">×</button>
          </div>

          ${canAlias ? `
            <label class="manage-modal-field">
              <span>Alias asta</span>
              <div class="manage-modal-alias-row">
                <input
                  id="manage-modal-team-alias"
                  maxlength="10"
                  value="${esc(team.auction_alias || '')}"
                  placeholder="MAX 10"
                  autocomplete="off"
                >
                <button id="manage-modal-save-alias" type="button">Salva alias</button>
              </div>
            </label>
          ` : ''}

          <section class="manage-president-box">
            <div class="manage-president-current">
              <span>Presidente</span>
              <strong>${president ? esc(president.username) : 'NON ASSEGNATO'}</strong>
            </div>

            ${canManagePresident ? `
              <div class="manage-president-actions">
                ${president ? `
                  <button id="manage-modal-remove-president" class="danger" type="button">Rimuovi Presidente</button>
                ` : `
                  <select id="manage-modal-president-select">
                    <option value="">Seleziona Presidente...</option>
                    ${candidates.map(member => `<option value="${esc(member.userId)}">${esc(member.username)}</option>`).join('')}
                  </select>
                  <button id="manage-modal-assign-president" type="button">Assegna</button>
                `}
              </div>
            ` : ''}
          </section>

          <div class="manage-team-modal-footer">
            <button id="manage-modal-close-footer" class="secondary" type="button">Chiudi</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      const aliasInput = $('manage-modal-team-alias');
      aliasInput?.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const caret = aliasInput.selectionStart;
        aliasInput.value = aliasInput.value.toLocaleUpperCase('it-IT').slice(0, 10);
        if (caret !== null) {
          const next = Math.min(caret, aliasInput.value.length);
          aliasInput.setSelectionRange(next, next);
        }
      });

      $('manage-team-modal-close')?.addEventListener('click', closeManageTeamModal);
      $('manage-modal-close-footer')?.addEventListener('click', closeManageTeamModal);

      $('manage-modal-save-alias')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const alias = String($('manage-modal-team-alias')?.value || '')
          .trim()
          .toLocaleUpperCase('it-IT');

        if (alias.length > 10) {
          return msg('L’alias asta può contenere al massimo 10 caratteri.', 'error');
        }

        try {
          await api(ENDPOINTS.league, {
            action: 'setTeamAlias',
            teamId,
            alias
          });
          msg(alias ? `Alias asta salvato: ${alias}` : 'Alias asta rimosso.', 'success');
          closeManageTeamModal();
          await Promise.all([loadManagement(), loadDashboard()]);
        } catch (error) {
          msg(error.message, 'error');
        }
      });

            action: 'assignPresident',
            teamId,
            targetUserId
          });
          msg('Presidente assegnato.', 'success');
          closeManageTeamModal();
          await Promise.all([loadManagement(), loadDashboard()]);
        } catch (error) {
          msg(error.message, 'error');
        }
      });

        if (!president) return;

            action: 'unassignPresident',

          });

        } catch (error) {
          msg(error.message, 'error');
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        closeManageTeamModal();
      }, { once: true });

      if (!dialog.open) {
        dialog.showModal();
      }
    }

    function renderManagement() {
      const data = state.management;
      if (!data) return;

      $('create-team-form').hidden = !data.permissions?.canCreateTeam;

      $('manage-teams').innerHTML = (data.teams || []).map(team => {

          member.team?.teamId === team.id
          && member.team?.role === 'president'
          && member.team?.status === 'active'
        );

        const canRename = Boolean(
          data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin
          || data.permissions?.myPresidentTeamId === team.id
        );

        const canDelete = data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin === true;
        const canManageOverview = Boolean(
          data.permissions?.isLeagueAdmin
          || data.permissions?.canAssignPresident
        );

        return `
          <div class="compact-row manage-team-row">
            <div class="manage-team-identity">
              <strong>${esc(team.name)}</strong>
              <small>${president ? `Presidente: ${esc(president.username)}` : 'Presidente non assegnato'}</small>
              ${team.auction_alias ? `<small class="manage-team-alias-readout">Alias asta: <b>${esc(team.auction_alias)}</b></small>` : ''}
            </div>

            <div class="manage-team-actions">
              ${canManageOverview ? `
                <button
                  class="secondary team-icon-btn manage-team-overview"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Gestisci alias e Presidente"
                  aria-label="Gestisci alias e Presidente di ${esc(team.name)}"
                >⚙</button>
              ` : ''}

              ${canRename ? `
                <button
                  class="secondary team-icon-btn rename-team"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  data-name="${esc(team.name)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Rinomina squadra"
                  aria-label="Rinomina ${esc(team.name)}"
                >✎</button>
              ` : ''}

              ${canDelete ? `
                <button
                  class="danger team-icon-btn delete-team"
                  data-team="${esc(team.id)}"
                  data-name="${esc(team.name)}"
                  type="button"
                  title="Elimina squadra"
                  aria-label="Elimina ${esc(team.name)}"
                >×</button>
              ` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('') || '<div class="small soft">Nessuna squadra.</div>';

        button.addEventListener('click', () => openManageTeamModal(button.dataset.team));
      });

        button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const currentName = button.dataset.name || '';
          const raw = await appPrompt('Nuovo nome squadra', currentName);
          if (raw === null) return;

          if (teamName.length < 2 || teamName.length > 60) {
            return msg('Il nome della squadra deve avere tra 2 e 60 caratteri.', 'error');

          if (teamName === currentName) return;

            await api(ENDPOINTS.league, {
              action: 'renameTeam',
              teamId: button.dataset.team,

    $('create-team-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {

    async function viceAction(action, targetUserId) {
      try {
        await api(ENDPOINTS.league, { action, targetUserId });
        msg(action === 'approveVice' ? 'Vice approvato.' : 'Richiesta Vice rifiutata.', 'success');
        await loadManagement();
      } catch (error) { msg(error.message, 'error'); }
    }

    /* =====================================================
       SETUP
       ===================================================== */

    async function loadSetup() {
      let settings = null;

      /* Fonte primaria: league_settings via league-api. */
      const direct = await api(
        ENDPOINTS.league,
        { action: 'getSetup' },
        { quiet: true }
      );

      if (direct?.ok && direct.settings) {
        settings = direct.settings;
      }

      /*
       * Fallback: auction-api legge la stessa league_settings
       * per costruire la lobby. Utile se il browser sta ancora
       * parlando con una vecchia revisione di league-api.
       */
      if (!settings) {
        const lobby = await api(
          ENDPOINTS.auction,
          { action: 'getLobby' },
          { quiet: true }
        );

        if (lobby?.ok && lobby.settings) {
          settings = lobby.settings;
        }
      }

      if (!settings) {
        throw new Error('Impossibile leggere il Setup salvato nel database.');
      }

      state.setup = settings;
      populateSetup(settings);
    }

    function parseRosterConfig(value) {
      if (!value) return {};
      if (typeof value === 'object') return value;

      try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
      } catch {
        return {};
      }
    }

    const DEFAULT_DYNAMIC_TIMER_BANDS = [
      { max_percent: 2, seconds: 5 },
      { max_percent: 5, seconds: 7 },
      { max_percent: 10, seconds: 9 },
      { max_percent: 20, seconds: 12 },
      { max_percent: null, seconds: 15 }
    ];

    function normalizeDynamicTimerBands(value) {
      const source =
        Array.isArray(value?.bands)
          ? value.bands
          : Array.isArray(value)
            ? value
            : DEFAULT_DYNAMIC_TIMER_BANDS;

      const bands = source
        .map(item => ({
          max_percent:
            item?.max_percent === null
            || item?.max_percent === ''
              ? null
              : Number(item?.max_percent),
          seconds: Number(item?.seconds)
        }))
        .filter(item =>
          Number.isFinite(item.seconds)
          && item.seconds >= 1
          && (
            item.max_percent === null
            || (
              Number.isFinite(item.max_percent)
              && item.max_percent > 0
            )
          )
        );

      const finite = bands
        .filter(item => item.max_percent !== null)
        .sort((a, b) => a.max_percent - b.max_percent);

      const fallback =
        bands.find(item => item.max_percent === null)
        || { max_percent: null, seconds: finite.at(-1)?.seconds || 15 };

      return [...finite, fallback].slice(0, 8);
    }

    function collectDynamicTimerBands() {
      const rows = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll('.setup-timer-band')
      );

      if (!rows.length) {
        return normalizeDynamicTimerBands(null);
      }

      return normalizeDynamicTimerBands(
        rows.map((row, index) => ({
          max_percent:
            index === rows.length - 1
              ? null
              : Number(row.querySelector('[data-timer-percent]')?.value),
          seconds:
            Number(row.querySelector('[data-timer-seconds]')?.value)
        }))
      );
    }

    function renderDynamicTimerBands(value) {
      const container = $('setup-dynamic-timer-bands');
      if (!container) return;

      const bands = normalizeDynamicTimerBands(
        value ?? state.setupDynamicTimerBands
      );

      state.setupDynamicTimerBands = bands;

      container.innerHTML = bands.map((band, index) => {
        const last = index === bands.length - 1;

        return `
          <div class="setup-timer-band" data-timer-band="${index}">
            <label class="setup-timer-percent">
              ${last ? 'Fascia finale' : 'Fino al % dei crediti'}
              <input
                data-timer-percent
                type="number"
                min="0.1"
                max="999"
                step="0.1"
                value="${last ? '' : band.max_percent}"
                placeholder="Oltre le soglie"
                ${last ? 'disabled' : ''}
              >
            </label>

            <label>
              Secondi
              <input
                data-timer-seconds
                type="number"
                min="1"
                max="120"
                step="1"
                value="${band.seconds}"
              >
            </label>

            <button
              class="secondary"
              type="button"
              data-remove-timer-band="${index}"
              title="Rimuovi fascia"
              ${last || bands.length <= 2 ? 'disabled' : ''}
            >×</button>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function setupRoleOrderOptions(mode) {
      return mode === 'mantra'
        ? [
            ['free', 'Libero'],
            ['goalkeepers_first', 'Prima portieri']
          ]
        : [
            ['free', 'Libero'],
            ['pdca', 'PDCA'],
            ['acdp', 'ACDP'],
            ['p_free', 'P-libero']
          ];
    }

    function populateSetupRoleOrder(selectedValue) {
      const select = $('setup-role-order');
      if (!select) return;

      const options = setupRoleOrderOptions(
        $('setup-fantasy-mode').value
      );

      select.innerHTML = options
        .map(([value, label]) =>
          `<option value="${value}">${label}</option>`
        )
        .join('');

      select.value = options.some(([value]) => value === selectedValue)
        ? selectedValue
        : 'free';
    }

    function populateSetup(s) {
      const roster = parseRosterConfig(s.roster_config);

      $('setup-fantasy-mode').value = s.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
      $('setup-credits').value = s.initial_credits ?? 500;
